system.description:
This incantation grants temporary life to an object up to the size of a carriage, allowing it to move and obey simple commands. It cannot speak, but it can perform general tasks as well as ones suited to its function: for example, an animated plume could write a note or take dictation.

This incantation lasts 10 minutes (1 dungeon action), and each spark doubles that duration. With seven sparks, the effect is permanent.
